sources.quote: PlayStation 5 Digital Edition Specifications External dimensions(excluding projecting parts) Approx. 358 × 80 × 216 mm(width × height × depth)
If you purchase the PS5 Digital Edition, you can add the Ultra HD Blu-ray Disc Drive for PS5 later, as it will also be sold separately
A horizontal stand will be included with the new PS5 model.
Smaller PS5 design comes with 1TB storage for PS5 and PS5 Digital Edition

notes: Sony's PlayStation Blog post of 2023-10-10 announcing the smaller PS5 (the model that became CFI-2000; the post prints no model number). Axes labelled (width × height × depth), excluding projecting parts. The later CFI-21XX instruction manual (CFI-2116, en-gb) prints the same 358 × 96 × 216 / 358 × 80 × 216 mm but 'Approx. 3.1 kg' / 'Approx. 2.5 kg': that is the CFI-2100 revision, a different model, so its masses are not candidates here.

ports not filed: the post's Input/Output rows list two Type-C at the front, two SuperSpeed Type-A at the back and Ethernet, but its Video Out row names no HDMI port, so the list as printed is not the complete connector list. The CFI-21XX manual (later revision) lists 'USB Type-A port (SuperSpeed USB 10Gbps) ×2', two Type-C ports, an 'M.2 SSD expansion connector (Key M)', a 'Disc drive port', Ethernet and 'HDMI™ OUT port'.
media = []: sold without a disc drive; the drive is a separately sold add-on that attaches to the disc drive port. Disc and digital bodies differ in height (96 vs 80 mm), so they are two objects.
released null (month only). external_ids: Wikidata has no separate item for the slim Digital Edition; left null.
